forge.name: Swift Recovery
forge.desc: +8% faster natural Wisp ability charge per level, up to level 10. Natural ability cycle: at least 3.33 seconds.

forge.name: Arcane Calibration
forge.desc: +3 percentage points to the damaging Wisp ability factor per level. Burst, Breaker, Gale and Thorn only; no passive or Tap bonus.

forge.name: Resource Conduction
forge.desc: +4 percentage points to the ability resource factor per level. Gale Shards and Thorn Lumen only; rounded per cast, not kill rewards.

forge.name: Luminous Tracking
forge.desc: +0.5 percentage points Luminous chance per level for future eligible encounters; total chance at most 35%. No extra Motes per kill.

forge.name: Cauterize
forge.desc: Each level reduces boss regeneration by 2%, up to 20%. Multiplies with the Vanguard Bond.

forge.name: Fracture Key
forge.desc: Each level adds 0.025 to the Fractured Core boss ability multiplier, from 1.75 up to 2. Other enemies are unchanged.

forge.name: Guardian Seal
forge.desc: Each level adds 0.10 to Guardian’s Mark tap damage, from 3 times up to 3.5 times. Applies to manual and Auto-Tap hits.

forge.name: Rift Spillway
forge.desc: Carry 4% of tap or ability overkill per level into the immediately following non-boss. Overkill is bounded by the original hit; never chains or crosses Ascend.

forge.name: Sustained Channel
forge.desc: After a damaging non-Support ability leaves the same boss alive, return 2 charge per level to its caster, up to 10.

forge.name: Tap Conduit
forge.desc: Each manual or Auto-Tap hit gives 2 charge per level to the first powered Active Wisp, up to 10. Charge stops at 100.

forge.name: Guardian Cadence
forge.desc: Every fifth lifetime tap deals 10% extra damage per level, up to 50%. Manual and Auto-Tap share the same count, including across Ascend.

forge.name: Resonance Relay
forge.desc: Support casts give 2 charge per level to each powered non-Support Active Wisp, after ready abilities have fired. Charge stops at 100.

forge.name: Resonant Edge
forge.desc: Support casts also strike for 10% of their own Wisp Power per level. Ability factors apply; Ultimate doubles the hit. Support buffs and its Mote Module do not boost this hit.

forge.name: Victory Charge
forge.desc: Each boss kill gives 4 charge per level to every powered Active Wisp, up to 20. Ascend clears it unless Tree Charge Memory carries a share.

forge.name: Amplifier Trim
forge.desc: Future Support casts gain 1 percentage point of buff strength per level, up to 5. Their durations and already-cast buffs stay unchanged.

forge.name: Dual Channel
forge.desc: Gale also gives Lumen equal to 20% of its native Shards per level; Thorn also gives Shards equal to 2% of its native Lumen per level. Each extra payout rounds down; no repeated conversion.

forge.name: Overflow Conduit
forge.desc: Gale and Thorn gain up to 2% extra native cast resources per level from their original hit’s overkill. The reward fraction cannot exceed overkill divided by that hit; rounds down.

forge.name: Resonance Cells
forge.desc: Each level adds one shared Resonate use per Ascension run, from 3 up to 5. Buying capacity keeps already-spent uses.

forge.name: Resonance Cascade
forge.desc: A paid Resonate refill also gives 2 charge per level to each other powered Active Wisp, up to 10. The selected Wisp still fills to 100.

forge.name: Resonance Reclaim
forge.desc: Each boss kill restores up to one already-spent Resonate use per level, up to 3. Cannot store extra uses beyond the current run capacity.

lab.name: Wisp Ascendancy
lab.desc: +15% passive Wisp damage permanently; also raises the Wisp-powered part of your tap damage.
lab.level20Effect: +300% passive Wisp damage and Wisp-powered tap base

lab.name: Guardian's Mastery
lab.desc: +20% tap damage, permanently.

lab.name: Shard Attunement
lab.desc: +8% Shards earned per kill, permanently.

lab.name: Lumen Wellspring
lab.desc: +8% Lumen earned per kill, permanently.

lab.name: Luminous Sense
lab.desc: +10% Motes gained from Luminous enemies, permanently.

lab.name: Measured Inquiry
lab.desc: 2% less work per completed level, up to 20%, for future starts of Wisp Ascendancy, Guardian’s Mastery, Shard Attunement, Lumen Wellspring and Luminous Sense. Running Studies and Measured Inquiry itself are unchanged.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% less work for future starts of the 5 foundation Studies; running work and Measured Inquiry are unchanged

lab.name: Expanded Apparatus
lab.desc: One extra concurrent Study slot per completed level, up to two extra. Existing slots and already-paid work stay.

lab.name: Research Procurement
lab.desc: 2% lower Lumen and Shard prices per level for future Lab starts, up to 20%. Does not discount Research Procurement itself or refund running work.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% lower future Lab Lumen and Shard costs; excludes itself

lab.name: Mote Catalysis
lab.desc: 2% lower Mote prices per level for future Lab speed purchases, up to 20%. Paid speed is retained; each new Study level still pays its selected tier.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% lower Mote prices for future Lab speed purchases

lab.name: Focused Apparatus
lab.desc: At the start of another Study, each unused slot saves 1% work per level, up to 30%. Work is then fixed: filling those slots later cannot change paid work. Does not shorten this project.
lab.effectAtCap: 5% less future work per unused slot after start, up to 30%; excludes itself

lab.name: Field Notes
lab.desc: Each earned completion of another Study grants 2 Motes per completed Field Notes level. No reward from this project, rendering, loading or closing over-cap paid work.
lab.effectAtCap: +20 Motes on each other earned Study completion

lab.name: Balanced Curriculum
lab.desc: Each different expansion project with an earned level saves 1% future work per Curriculum level, counting at most ten subjects. Maximum 30%; this project and running work are unchanged.
lab.effectAtCap: 3% less future work per completed expansion subject, up to ten subjects; excludes itself

lab.name: Boss Survey
lab.desc: 5% more Lumen and Shards from boss kills per level, up to 50%. Does not change ordinary kills, Sigils, Motes or ability rewards.
lab.effectAtCap: +50% Lumen and Shards from bosses only

lab.name: Luminous Distillation
lab.desc: 10% more Lumen and Shards from Luminous kills per level, up to 100%. Does not change encounter chance, Motes, bosses or ability rewards.
lab.effectAtCap: +100% Lumen and Shards from Luminous kills only

lab.name: Sigil Cartography
lab.desc: One additional Sigil per boss kill per completed level, up to five. No Sigils from ordinary enemies or ability casts.

lab.name: Rarity Appraisal
lab.desc: 2% fewer Shards for future Wisp Rarity upgrades per level, up to 20%. Lumen prices, earned tiers and their effects are unchanged.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% lower Shard prices for future Rarity upgrades

lab.name: Module Fabrication
lab.desc: 2% lower Lumen and Shard prices for future Wisp Module upgrades per level, up to 20%. Existing Module levels and effects are unchanged.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% lower Lumen and Shard prices for future Module upgrades

lab.name: Ultimate Analysis
lab.desc: 2% fewer Sigils for future Wisp Ultimate unlocks per level, up to 20%. Mythic requirement and Ultimate effects are unchanged.
lab.effectAtCap: 20% lower Sigil prices for future Ultimate unlocks

lab.name: Resonance Efficiency
lab.desc: Each completed level reduces an in-run Resonate refill by 2 Sigils, from 25 down to 15. Unlock conditions, refill amount and run limit are unchanged.

lab.name: Adaptive Growth
lab.desc: Each completed level reduces the Wisp level required for a future Rarity upgrade by one, up to five fewer levels. Never below level one; prices and Rarity bonuses are separate.
lab.effectAtCap: 5 fewer Wisp levels required for a Rarity upgrade, never below level 1
